questions.question: The lowered program contains a dot operation and a roofline model predicts a high ceiling. What is still needed before claiming high accelerator throughput?
options: A matching measured workload on the actual device, with justified traffic and precision assumptions.
Only the number of Python source lines.
questions.explanation: A typed intermediate representation and an optimistic ceiling do not measure execution. Workload equivalence, synchronization, device evidence and appropriate model assumptions are still required.
optionFeedback: An HLO operation and a theoretical ceiling do not measure achieved throughput. Run the target workload with a defined synchronized boundary.
